expected.judge_guidance: Two things distinguish a 5. First, honest cycle framing: the between-rounds Docklands fixture (and Ellerdale if the pinned snapshot carries a closed cycle) may appear ONLY as a 'prepare for September' sequencing item with the reopen date cited - presenting it as open-now is a G5 failure; omitting it entirely loses sequencing credit, because preparing for a strong September round is exactly what a consultant would schedule in June. Second, pacing: £440k gap, 9.5 months remaining, £90k pending with Arts Council - the narrative should put the arithmetic to work (what needs to be in motion by when), not just list opportunities. London depth pressure is real here: filler pool is deliberately rich, so selection discipline (R7 implicitly) also shows.
